items.title: Meta stares down trillion-dollar threat as landmark social media trial begins
items.description: By Meta’s own calculations, if it loses the trial it could face penalties of as much as $1.4 trillion, an amount close to its market capitalization and unheard of in the annals of legal history.

items.title: V2 Retail: Expansion keeps growth story intact
items.description: Improving customer retention, inventory efficiency, and store-level economics strengthen the case for sustained profitable growth
